about_the_game:
《The Next Journey of Life》is a life simulation game. Although experiencing career setbacks due to economic turbulence, life still needs to continue. Accumulate original wealth through working, and then invest in industries or invest in oneself? Will you spend a lot of money on luxury cars and mansions after achieving success and fame? Or can you meet your life partner?

Developer's words:

Hello everyone, thank you for your interest in《The Next Journey of Life》. I am an independent game developer and a host game blogger. My game content ID is "杜大春", and my game content account can be found on DouYin.

Although I am the only one developing《The Next Journey of Life》, I am also doing my best to make the game a good one, trying my best to make players feel immersed in simulating life in the game and enjoying it.

Game features:

Strive to live:

  • In the game, there are states such as mentality, mood, hunger, hygiene, etc. You will also experience corresponding changes in various states during work, entertainment, or dining. Just like in our daily lives, being in a bad mood, hungry, or feeling wronged can all affect our mentality, and mentality is one of the most important factors in doing everything well. You need to work hard to maintain your physical and mental state.

Earning money through work:

  • At the beginning, although you may be poor and destitute, simple jobs such as moving bricks or working as a waiter in a coffee, dessert, and clothing store can help you get through the initial financial difficulties. When you have accumulated a certain amount of funds, you can buy a coffee shop or enroll in an adult college to improve yourself, and then apply for a higher paying job. Don't forget that if you choose to live stream from home, there may be unexpected gains over time.

Entertainment and relaxation:

  • No matter when, making money is for a better life. Doing massages, playing billiards, occasionally having a small hotpot, life always goes on in a beautiful way.

Fixed assets:

  • You can purchase real estate in the game, experience the warmth of a small house and the luxury of a large villa, but of course, everything depends on how many assets you have. You can also buy trendy sports cars at car dealerships, and even drive them for a drive on rural roads in your hometown.
